## useControllableState() function

The single state primitive every stateful prop in this library is built on. Supports three modes, chosen by which options are passed, all producing the same `[value, setValue]` shape:

- `value` present, no `store`<!-- -->: fully controlled — the consumer owns the value; `setValue` only calls `onChange`<!-- -->, it never updates anything locally. - `value` absent, no `store`<!-- -->: uncontrolled — backed by local React state seeded from `defaultValue`<!-- -->; `onChange` still fires on every update so an observing-only parent works too. - `store` present: delegates to the external [StoreController](./core.storecontroller.md) via `useSyncExternalStore` instead of local state. Takes priority over `value`<!-- -->/`defaultValue` when present.

See the `bio-viz-conventions` project skill for the full contract and the convention every component follows for wrapping this under a domain-specific prop name (e.g. `viewport`<!-- -->/ `defaultViewport`<!-- -->/`onViewportChange`<!-- -->/`viewportStore`<!-- -->).
